scope: Independent selected source-target confirmation only, official init21-24; discovery init20 is excluded from these subsets.

fixed_subsets.name: all4_init21_24
fixed_subsets.purpose: Primary inclusive actual measured cost across all four held-out initial states

fixed_subsets.name: first_task_init21
fixed_subsets.purpose: First scheduled initial state of each task; report separately without labeling every request cold

fixed_subsets.name: repeat_task_init22_24
fixed_subsets.purpose: Fixed repeated-task subset; not guaranteed free of compilation/capture or other cold costs

selection_policy: Include every valid planned episode in each fixed subset, irrespective of success, failure, duration, request latency, acceptance or fallback. Technical interruptions remain explicit; no outcome/speed filtering or favorable reruns.
execution_context: Existing manifest orders each task init21,22,23,24 in a persistent same-source/mode service. Confirm order from manifest. If service restarts, preserve the fixed subset and disclose the restart; never silently exclude its costs.

metrics.primary: sum(complete native policy-call wall ms, including rejected zero-action requests) / sum(actually executed actions)
metrics.secondary: sum(complete client RPC ms) / sum(actually executed actions)
metrics.quality: Successful episodes / valid completed episodes and actual episode-wall totals/means for every subset
metrics.full_run_cost: For all four inits, report run wall_seconds, closed_loop_seconds, sum episode wall, and preparation_seconds separately. Do not subtract preparation from per-request latency; lazy graph construction may occur after service readiness.
metrics.preparation_attribution: Preparation is a once-per-run separate cost. Do not assign it entirely to init21 or prorate it away from repeat-task subsets. Preserve missing cost fields as missing.
metrics.gpu_stage: Retain native stage costs as diagnostics only; GPU-stage timings are not complete policy/RPC or end-to-end latency.
metrics.mean_request_latency: Diagnostic only; it cannot by itself support actual acceleration because rejected FLASH requests may execute zero actions.

comparisons: Within each fixed subset, pair identical target suite/task/init cases. Compare foreign source against target-matching source within the same mode, and each condition against Full. Report reference/condition per-action cost ratios, actual episode-wall ratio, both success counts and matched n. Do not mix discovery or first-task and repeat-task rows.

rejected_surrogates: did_prefill denotes Full-route prefix computation, not first compilation
is_full_pipeline_round/ease_initial_full denote policy routing/reset, not CUDA graph capture
latency threshold or first-request index cannot prove cold versus warm
NVTX graph-replay labels are not persisted per-request capture-success indicators
cold_marker_audit.conclusion: No request-level warm/cold partition will be manufactured. The fixed init22-24 result is named repeat-task, never deployment warm-state acceleration. New direct instrumentation would require a separate prospectively registered measurement.

reporting_bounds: Inclusive costs answer this evaluated run workload; repeated-task costs describe the fixed later initial states. Neither alone proves deployment steady-state speedup. Preserve actual success/trajectory differences and technical gaps.
